intro.text: A member of House Cett who represents the house in the Elendel Senate.

items.text: When Steris asked the Senate for a select council on the Outer Cities, Darlin voted for it, knowing he would sit on it. At its meeting he pressed for a preemptive strike on the Outer Cities, arguing that if Elendel waited it would soon be unable to win.
As soon as word came that an Outer Cities bomb was aimed at Elendel, Darlin began arranging to flee the city.

appearance.text: Darlin dresses well, with slicked-back, thinning hair, and wears powder, probably to whiten his skin in the fashion of 348 PC.

personality.text: Darlin knows Elendel politics well and leans hawkish, favoring a first strike against the Outer Cities, yet when the bomb threat emerged he put his own safety ahead of the common people's.
